G5-01.title: Finding shapes without forcing them
G5-01.central_question: What can we notice in a leaf, flower, shell or stone?
learning_objectives: Distinguish an observed specimen from an ideal shape
Describe a visible repetition accurately
G5-01.further_research: Which local specimens show useful variation?

G5-02.title: Symmetry you can move and fold
G5-02.central_question: How can we test whether two parts match?
learning_objectives: Find a reflection line by folding
Distinguish a reflection from a turn

G5-03.title: Sketching families of shapes
G5-03.central_question: What makes a triangle a triangle when we turn it?
learning_objectives: Recognize figures in varied orientations
Compare curved and straight boundaries
G5-03.further_research: How can a drawing communicate its intended shape?

G5-04.title: A circle with one string
G5-04.central_question: What must stay unchanged while we draw?
learning_objectives: Trace a fixed-distance circle
Explain the role of center and radius
G5-04.further_research: Compare string action with a compass hinge.

G6-01.title: The tools and the language
G6-01.central_question: How can we give instructions someone else can repeat?
learning_objectives: Use compass and straightedge with control
Distinguish point, segment, ray and line
G6-01.further_research: How should accessible instructions describe a point without color?

G6-02.title: Constructing circles accurately
G6-02.central_question: Why does a compass draw a circle?
learning_objectives: Construct and label a circle
Relate radius and diameter

G6-03.title: Six equal steps around a circle
G6-03.central_question: Why does the radius fit six times around the circle as a chord?
learning_objectives: Construct a regular hexagon by constant-radius steps
Explain the six equilateral triangles
G6-03.further_research: How does a polygon’s perimeter approach a circle’s circumference?

G6-04.title: Triangles and stars inside the circle
G6-04.central_question: How do the same six points generate different figures?
learning_objectives: Construct equilateral triangles from alternate vertices
Explain rotational repetition
G6-04.further_research: Which rotations map the hexagon to itself?

G6-05.title: A right angle made with rope
G6-05.central_question: How can we lay out a square corner outdoors?
learning_objectives: Build a 3–4–5 triangle from equal intervals
Recognize the angle opposite the longest side
G6-05.further_research: Why do intervals, rather than the number of visible knots, define lengths?

G6-06.title: Finding the midpoint without measuring
G6-06.central_question: How can equal distances find a center?
learning_objectives: Construct a perpendicular bisector
Explain why its points are equally distant from endpoints
G6-06.further_research: What changes if one arc radius is larger?

G6-07.title: Perpendiculars and parallels
G6-07.central_question: How do we construct directions that stay related?
learning_objectives: Construct a perpendicular at a point on a line
Construct a parallel through a separate point
G6-07.further_research: Why are parallel lines a plane relationship?

G6-08.title: Splitting an angle fairly
G6-08.central_question: How can we divide an angle into two equal parts?
learning_objectives: Construct an angle bisector
Differentiate angle and segment bisection
G6-08.further_research: What equal-sided triangles appear in the construction?

G6-09.title: Building squares and rectangles
learning_objectives: Construct a square with a given side
Distinguish squares from general rectangles
G6-09.further_research: Which properties are preserved when a square is rotated?

G6-10.title: Which triangles can we construct
G6-10.central_question: When do three given lengths meet?
learning_objectives: Construct a triangle from three lengths
Classify it by side and angle properties
G6-10.further_research: How are the two circle-intersection solutions related?

G6-11.title: Measuring turns and directions
G6-11.central_question: How can we measure an angle without being fooled by its arms?
learning_objectives: Measure acute, right and obtuse angles
Interpret simple compass bearings
G6-11.further_research: How can two scales on a protractor describe the same drawing?

G6-12.title: Keeping a shadow record
G6-12.central_question: What changes when the stick stays still?
learning_objectives: Record shadow length and direction under consistent conditions
Describe an observed trend without inventing data
G6-12.further_research: How does a same-clock-time shadow change over a month?

G6-13.title: Units and the boundary of a field
G6-13.central_question: Why must we agree on the unit?
learning_objectives: Measure and compute perimeter
Compare nonstandard and standard units
G6-13.further_research: How do we choose a useful unit size?

G6-14.title: Area is not perimeter
G6-14.central_question: How much ground fits inside the boundary?
learning_objectives: Build rectangle area from square units
Compare equal-perimeter figures with different areas
G6-14.further_research: Which rectangle maximizes area for this fixed perimeter?

G6-15.title: Design a small garden
G6-15.central_question: How can a drawing guide real construction?
learning_objectives: Integrate scale, right angles, perimeter and area
Explain a design using measurements
G6-15.further_research: How does a path reduce planting area without changing the outer boundary?

G6-16.title: A pattern that fits and a pattern that fails
learning_objectives: Test simple regular tilings
Explain a failed fit using angles or visible gaps
G6-16.further_research: What changes if unlike polygons are mixed?

G7-01.title: When a picture is not enough
G7-01.central_question: What turns a convincing example into a reason?
learning_objectives: Distinguish observation, conjecture and proof
Supply a reason for a simple angle statement
G7-01.further_research: How can one counterexample refute an all-cases claim?

G7-02.title: Why triangle angles make a straight angle
G7-02.central_question: How do parallel lines explain a triangle?
learning_objectives: Use alternate interior angles
Justify the 180° triangle angle sum
G7-02.further_research: How does a spherical triangle differ?

G7-03.title: Same shape at a different size
G7-03.central_question: What must remain unchanged in an enlargement?
learning_objectives: Identify corresponding sides
Apply a scale factor consistently
G7-03.further_research: Why does length scale differ from area scale?

G7-04.title: Measure a tree without climbing
G7-04.central_question: How can a smaller triangle measure a larger one?
learning_objectives: Model simultaneous shadows with similar triangles
Calculate and check an unknown height
G7-04.further_research: How should two disagreeing measurements be reported?

G7-05.title: The part of the shadow we cannot see
G7-05.central_question: Why is the pyramid problem harder than the pole problem?
learning_objectives: Distinguish vertical and slant height
Include the hidden base distance in an aligned pyramid model
G7-05.further_research: How does the correction change when the shadow points toward a corner?

G7-06.title: Cutting and sliding area
G7-06.central_question: Why does a slanted shape still have a simple area?
learning_objectives: Derive parallelogram and triangle area
Identify perpendicular height
G7-06.further_research: How can the same triangle use different base-height pairs?

G7-07.title: Measuring around and inside a circle
G7-07.central_question: Why do circumference and area use different formulas?
learning_objectives: Estimate π from diameter and circumference
Distinguish C=2πr from A=πr²
G7-07.further_research: Why does using a thicker string affect the estimate?

G7-08.title: Squares on the sides
G7-08.central_question: What pattern links the three squares of a right triangle?
learning_objectives: Identify legs and hypotenuse in any orientation
Check the area relation in two cases
G7-08.further_research: How can a diagram make units of area visible?

G7-09.title: A proof made from four triangles
G7-09.central_question: Why must the area relation hold for any right triangle?
learning_objectives: Reconstruct a rearrangement proof
Explain both area invariance and the central square
G7-09.further_research: Which earlier angle fact proves the central corners are 90°?

G7-10.title: Using the theorem wisely
G7-10.central_question: How do we choose the unknown before calculating?
learning_objectives: Solve for a missing leg or hypotenuse
Check a proposed right-triangle side set
G7-10.further_research: How could measurement error affect a right-angle check?

G7-11.title: A diagonal that fractions cannot capture
learning_objectives: Locate √2 between rational bounds
Distinguish exact value and approximation
G7-11.further_research: What distinguishes repeating and nonrepeating infinite decimals?

G7-12.title: Ratios we can hear and arrange
G7-12.central_question: How do numbers connect sound and shape?
learning_objectives: Compare simple string-length ratios
Build triangular and square number patterns
G7-12.further_research: What physical conditions change string pitch besides length?

G7-13.title: The right angle hidden in a semicircle
G7-13.central_question: Why does one point moving on a circle preserve a right angle?
learning_objectives: Construct a triangle on a diameter
Justify the semicircle theorem using equal radii
G7-13.further_research: How does the proof work when the center lies on a triangle side?

G7-14.title: Constructing a root five rectangle
G7-14.central_question: Can we construct an exact irrational length?
learning_objectives: Construct √5 from a 1-by-2 right triangle
Distinguish exact construction from decimal measurement
G7-14.further_research: How can the semicircle’s diameter be √5 times the inscribed square side?

G7-15.title: A line divided in a special proportion
G7-15.central_question: What makes the golden division self-related?
learning_objectives: State the short-long-whole relationship
Construct a golden rectangle from a square
G7-15.further_research: Which pentagon diagonals reproduce this ratio?

G7-16.title: A small survey with reasons
G7-16.central_question: Can someone else reproduce our measurement?
learning_objectives: Combine construction, similarity and calculation
Communicate assumptions and a reproducible method
G7-16.further_research: Which change would most improve the reliability of this estimate?

G8-01.title: Building a chain of reasons
learning_objectives: Distinguish definition, assumption and theorem
Order a short proof by dependencies
G8-01.further_research: Which assumptions are hidden in a familiar diagram?

G8-02.title: Why some regular polygons tile
G8-02.central_question: Can we predict whether a shape will fit?
learning_objectives: Derive regular polygon interior angles
Classify single-type edge-to-edge regular tilings
G8-02.further_research: What changes when two polygon types are allowed?

G8-03.title: From a flat net to a solid
G8-03.central_question: Which edges will meet when we fold?
learning_objectives: Recognize valid cube and tetrahedron nets
Track face and edge adjacency
G8-03.further_research: How many different cube nets can the class find without claiming completeness?

G8-04.title: Why exactly five regular convex solids
G8-04.central_question: What restricts the corners of a solid?
learning_objectives: Use face-angle sums to list possible regular vertices
Connect the five possibilities to five solids
G8-04.further_research: Why do the local possibilities also yield closed solids?

G8-05.title: Counting and pairing the solids
G8-05.central_question: How are faces and vertices connected?
learning_objectives: Count V,E,F without omitting hidden parts
Identify cube–octahedron and dodecahedron–icosahedron dual pairs

G8-06.title: Wrapping a box and filling it
G8-06.central_question: Why do surface area and volume behave differently?
learning_objectives: Compute surface area and volume of rectangular prisms
Use square and cubic units correctly
G8-06.further_research: Which box needs less wrapping for the same volume?

G8-07.title: A pentagon with a reason
G8-07.central_question: How can golden proportion help construct fivefold symmetry?
learning_objectives: Construct a regular pentagon from a verified procedure
Relate its diagonals to golden proportion

G8-08.title: What does doubling a cube mean
G8-08.central_question: How do changes in length affect space?
learning_objectives: Apply linear, area and volume scale factors
Explain the difference between double edge and double volume
G8-08.further_research: How can a measuring approximation exist when an exact classical construction does not?

G8-09.title: Curves made by cutting a cone
G8-09.central_question: What changes when we tilt the cutting plane?
learning_objectives: Recognize circle, ellipse, parabola and hyperbola as sections
Connect an ellipse to a constant-distance-sum construction
G8-09.further_research: How can the cutting condition and the locus condition describe the same curve?

G8-10.title: Measuring the Earth with a shadow
G8-10.central_question: How does a local angle tell us a whole circumference?
learning_objectives: Explain the parallel-ray angle relation
Calculate circumference from an arc and angle
G8-10.further_research: How does a different stadion length alter the claimed modern accuracy?

G8-11.title: How certain is our answer
learning_objectives: Report a sensible estimate rather than false precision
Explore sensitivity to input error
G8-11.further_research: How should uncertain angle and distance be combined responsibly?

G8-12.title: A geometry exhibition that teaches
G8-12.central_question: Can we help someone else see why a result is true?
learning_objectives: Create a coherent mathematical demonstration
Distinguish story, observation, model and proof
G8-12.further_research: What unanswered question naturally follows the exhibit?

E-01.title: Proving that root two is irrational
E-01.central_question: How can we rule out every fraction at once?
learning_objectives: Follow a proof by contradiction
Explain why lowest terms matter
E-01.further_research: Can the method be adapted to √3?

E-02.title: A second proof of Pythagoras
E-02.central_question: How can different proofs explain the same theorem?
learning_objectives: Compare dissection and a Euclidean area proof
Track reasons across a longer argument
E-02.further_research: Why might one proof be easier for a particular problem?

E-03.title: Proportion beyond fraction notation
E-03.central_question: How can we compare magnitudes without assuming a common unit?
learning_objectives: Explain commensurable and incommensurable lengths
Connect Eudoxus’s problem to geometric ratios
E-03.further_research: How did later definitions of real number change the language?

E-04.title: Impossible under which rules
E-04.central_question: What would count as a solution?
learning_objectives: State classical tool restrictions accurately
Distinguish exact, approximate and alternate-tool constructions
E-04.further_research: How do origami axioms change what can be constructed?
